Reset Password

Set a new password for this employee.

Add Employee

Adds a new row to the Staff Directory — assign them a login separately from Manage Accounts.

Add Employee to Schedule

Adds them as a new row to this week's schedule so you can assign their shifts. They must already exist under All Employees.

Remove Employee from Schedule

Removes them from this week's schedule grid and marks them inactive on the roster, so they won't be offered when building future schedules. Their attendance, evaluation, disciplinary, and other history is never touched.
